title: The Generator Room
summary: On Day eleven, a pilot's crew waits in the basement and the super is locked behind a steel door.

beats.text: Day eleven. In the basement, a lantern clicked on. Three strangers stood by the generator.
Marek smiled. "My crew. They were afraid to come up."
Behind a steel door, someone knocked twice. Hale, locked in.
"The roof key also starts the tug, Sam. Do not hand it over."
beats.speaker: hale

beats.text: Marek held out his palm. "Keys first."
I smiled back and lied. "The key is upstairs, in 9C."
Mrs. Okafor kicked a tin. The clang rolled up the dark.
Shapes shuffled from the shadows. Marek's crew ran, shoving past us.
Leo slid the bolt. Hale stumbled out with the generator key clenched in his fist.
We hid behind the mailboxes until the shouting stopped.
Under the cupboard door, a pair of boots stopped. Marek whispered, "Found you."
